newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian youth dies of Hebron clash wounds.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian youth dies of Hebron clash wounds.

text.p: A 14-year-old Palestinian, shot by Israeli soldiers in clashes in Hebron two weeks ago, has died of his wounds, witnesses at his funeral said on Monday.
Nibras Abu Sharkh was hit in the head by a rubber-coated metal bullet. He died in a hospital in Arab East Jerusalem.

Ten Palestinian military jeeps waited with Sharkh's mourning family at an Israeli checkpoint on Monday evening for an Israeli escort to take his body home to the West Bank town of Dhahriya for burial.

The divided West Bank town of Hebron was rocked by daily Israeli-Palestinian clashes after an Jewish woman pasted posters on storefronts in the town last month depicting the Moslem Prophet Mohammad as a pig.
The violence died down last week after Palestinian police deployed along the line dividing the Israeli and PLO-controlled sections of the city.
